result.markdown:
For a small business in the UK, I'd recommend **Xero, QuickBooks or FreeAgent**\. They are all strong options, but the best one depends on the type of business you run, how much bookkeeping you want to do yourself, and whether you're VAT registered.

Here's how I'd compare them in 2026.

## Best accounting software for small businesses

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Excellent for growing small businesses.
- Automatic bank feeds and reconciliation.
- Invoicing, VAT returns and financial reporting.
- Unlimited users on its plans.

Best if you want something professional that can grow with your business.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks**

(Best all-rounder)

- Easy invoicing and expense tracking.
- Good bank reconciliation.
- Useful profit and loss reports.
- Good mobile app.

Best if you want a comprehensive accounting package without needing an accountant to do everything.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![FreeAgent Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/4EW4hBD2EUDKpZ5vzXzleX_ZpFL7ewSrW-W7Xzirz-jzVn6P3X95jL6dKI2NWPTYUy9gNZv7yOizFlm19yyMsc2dO__uQrEAzf73EFerzDjWn8HeIwfhoQHLcLNQK7oPAsV7vFV9IfXwDWOGVcvob8QVbUIX7mb0cBSFqkVD_V3B8B9oQ_iqGrd2TgWEshaA?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. FreeAgent**

(Best for sole traders)

- Straightforward bookkeeping.
- Invoicing and expense management.
- VAT returns and tax calculations.
- Self Assessment support.

Particularly attractive if you have an eligible NatWest, RBS, Ulster Bank or Mettle account, as you may qualify for free access.

[FreeAgent website](https://www.freeagent.com/)

---

![Sage Group | Company Overview & News](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VFRaM7Mi6n-B6kypx5NEbH6uZ7gv6tyckO56Q4NaZ2LIxfSUsJX7-BpQgCEEs8eZ1yCTkoB51T4Vi6uho9n0Uh-lEm2VXgC1WYeJjEoJCLFmEjEBjRNPbTFFtsAcn4mH6vl8NHzKL61NACimMLcmOKip1T__uRJNPku-4fp2J-5qEQ-yptJXrboOZoUqd8Yu?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Sage**

- Strong UK accounting and tax features.
- Good for payroll and VAT.
- Suitable for more established businesses.

Best if you have employees or more complicated accounting requirements.

[Sage website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

- Good value for money.
- Automated bookkeeping.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.
- Free plan available for qualifying smaller businesses.

Best if keeping software costs down is important.

[Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/uk/books/)

These choices reflect recent UK comparisons of accounting features, ease of use, value and HMRC compatibility. ## Which one would I choose?

| Your business | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Sole trader | FreeAgent |
| Limited company | Xero |
| Small business with employees | Sage or Xero |
| Tradesperson / contractor | QuickBooks |
| Freelancer / consultant | FreeAgent |
| Growing business with multiple users | Xero |
| Tight budget | Zoho Books |


**One important UK consideration\:** Make sure the software supports Making Tax Digital (MTD) for Income Tax if your business needs it. The rules began applying to qualifying sole traders and landlords with income over £50,000 from April 2026. search_results.description:
This article reviews the best small business accounting software in the UK for 2026, highlighting nine solutions designed to simplify bookkeeping, invoicing, expense management, and tax compliance. Choosing suitable software can help businesses automate financial tasks, meet HMRC requirements under Making Tax Digital, and integrate accounting with banking and ecommerce platforms.

The recommended options cater to different business needs:

1. **QuickBooks:** Best overall, offering comprehensive accounting tools, automated bank feeds, cash flow insights, invoicing, and reporting.
2. **Sage Accounting:** Best for multiple users, with VAT submissions, bank reconciliation, forecasting, and detailed reporting.
3. **Xero:** Best for features, including expense tracking, budgeting, configurable reports, and unlimited users on supported plans.
4. **FreshBooks:** Best for versatility, combining invoicing, time tracking, expense management, and payment processing.
5. **Crunch:** Best for businesses seeking accounting software alongside guidance from real advisors.
6. **Zoho Books:** Best for automation, offering configurable workflows and scalable subscription plans.
7. **KashFlow:** Best for simplicity, with cloud accounting, VAT returns, and optional payroll functionality.
8. **FreeAgent:** Best budget option for freelancers and small businesses, combining invoicing, tax returns, payroll, and expense management.
9. **Adminsoft Accounts:** Best free basic solution, providing accounting, invoicing, stock control, and budgeting, supported by advertising.

The review evaluates usability, efficiency, features, affordability, scalability, and integration capabilities. Businesses should select software that matches their current requirements while accommodating future growth.
